cohort: Women who gave birth in health facilities in the Bolgatanga Municipality, Upper East Region, Ghana between 2010 and 2014 (n=24,171)
finding: Health facility deliveries increased steadily in the Bolgatanga Municipality between 2010 and 2014, with birth peaks in May, September, and October, and while caesarean section rates increased, stillbirth rates did not significantly improve.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rates steadily rose from 124 per 1000 births in 2010 to 185 per 1000 births in 2014.
